''See also: [[The Heart of Visiria Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Heart of [[Visiria]] is a highly potent restorative gem and a significant planetary treasure belonging to the world of [[Visiria]], which is a key member of the [[Karoshan Alliance]]. As an artifact blessed by the planet's [[World Spirit]], it possesses immense healing capabilities, though performing complex tasks with its energy typically requires a large group of people. The object is considered so valuable that the local Governor has implemented high-level security measures to protect it from theft. While its power can be depleted, it is capable of regaining its potency over time through the [[Aether]]. Beyond its medicinal uses, such as the potential to restore a [[Titan Knight]], the artifact is a source of political tension; possessing or attempting to take it can lead to conflict with the [[Karoshan Alliance]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Heart of [[Visiria]] is a smooth, fist-sized [[ruby]] that serves as one of the most powerful restorative artifacts in the galaxy. As a planetary treasure located on a world, this gem is the primary subject of a mission to obtain it. Although it is a treasure that can be stolen, its potential power is significant enough to be used to bring [[Parryl Cryce|Parryl]] back. Ultimately, the narrator intends to be sent to the location of the Heart of [[Visiria]].}}
